request: Please make rg --files include dotfiles ending in a dot without --hidden, since our generated .cache. directories should be searchable by default.

source.request: Please make rg --files include dotfiles ending in a dot without --hidden, since our generated .cache. directories should be searchable by default.
source.settled: On Unix, names that start and end with a dot are hidden unless hidden entries are explicitly included.
source.why: Including these names by default reverses the corrected hidden-file classification.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored.
